title: hakloud.art redefines healing with new release "Dear, heart it's time."
htmlContent: hakloud.art steps into the American songwriting tradition with "Dear, heart it's time." It's a reckoning, a quiet confession, and finally a way to move on. The duet has a warm, rough Country/Americana sound, like two voices coming together, one in pain, the other ready to heal. The song is about broken hearts that have been put back together, but it sounds more like you're reading someone's private letters than listening to a typical country ballad. "Dear, heart it's time." is a new take on an old art style, and the story doesn't see heartbreak as the end, but as a significant step toward growth. https://soundcloud.com/hakloud-art/singing-us-home-post-production-v1_3-2?utm_source=clipboard&utm_medium=text&utm_campaign=social_sharing The duet format makes heartbreak seem like a normal thing instead of a big deal. The two voices show different sides of the internal struggle of holding on and letting go, pain and strength. The track was made in Pro Tools, and the quietest parts of the song remain calm, while as the song builds to a powerful climax, the dynamic range ensures the emotional impact is felt with dignity rather than force. This release is a reminder that country music is for people who are brave enough to tell the truth and willing to listen with an open mind. "Dear, heart, it is time." is a gentle wake-up call, like someone shaking your heart and telling you it's time to let go. Follow hakloud.art on Instagram
